entities.name: Scorpion God
entities.description: Distorted god whose role was to kill the gods; killed Rhonas, Oketra and Kefnet, then was killed by Hazoret.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Planeswalker dragon who arrested and distorted three gods to serve his interests.

entities.name: Rhonas
entities.description: God killed by the Scorpion God.

entities.name: Hazoret
